notes: Total 60 as published. 'Purple Card' and 'Peeps' are section headers, not cards.

Starting cards per the strategy ('The Start'): Agents Of Black Sun, Coruscant, Coruscant: Imperial City, Prince Xizor, Prepared Defenses, Mobilization Points, Imperial Arrest Order and 'Effect Whatever'; no single starting Effect is set.

Censored weapon jokes: 'Boba Fett w/ @#$% Slap' dested Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; 'Iggy w/ @#$% Slap' IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'Dengar w/ Multi Slap' Dengar With Blaster Carbine; '4Lom w/ Big Shtick' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Hidden @#$% Slap x2' dested Hidden Weapons (the only Dark card starting 'Hidden'; judgment call).

Combos: 'Control Combo' Control & Set For Stun; 'Ghhk Combo' Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us; 'Sense Combo' Sense & Uncertain Is The Future; 'Defensive Fire Combo' Defensive Fire & Hutt Smooch; 'Evader Monnok' Evader & Monnok.
Posted 'DSI DB' dested Death Star: Docking Bay 327; 'Coruscant DB' and 'Endor DB' the Dark sites; 'Dengar In', 'Bossk In', 'Zuckass In' the pilot-in-ship cards; Secret Plans is the 2001 Effect.

The editorial says 'I have put in Point Man' and that changes since are not marked; Point Man is not in the posted list and was not added. The post says it is the second time the author posted this deck; no earlier post by him is in the archive set.
